hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a template with a free functional slot f: emit K(n)*f(n). Instantiate f as a(n) for the first member and as b(n) for the second member.
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), b(n) are defined expressions for the relevant n
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands share the exact same left factor K(n) and differ only in the function appearing in the right factor; a single functional template K(n)*f(n) captures this shared structure.
